name: Análisis de Espectro Radial
description: Analiza the radially-averaged frequency espectro for characteristic patrones. generado por IA images often show anomalous spectral profiles.
mechanism: Computes radially-averaged power espectro and analiza spectral profile shape. Deviations from natural profiles indicate manipulación.
parameters: FFT: adaptativo, Averaging: radial bins, Metric: profile deviation
useCase: Detecting spectral anomalías in generado por IA images

references.title: Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Networks. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures radial frequency distribución patrones
• Effective for detecting GAN checkerboard artefactos
• Azimuthal averaging reduces noise
• Content-independent análisis espectral
• Fast computation using FFT
limitations:
• Less effective for diffusion model artefactos
• compresión JPEG adds spectral noise
• Small images limit radial frequency resolución
• Isotropic assumption may miss directional artefactos
• Some generators produce clean radial spectra
